name: mgo-nfc
description: NFC office attendance: Flutter app + Firebase backend

scripts.test: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-mgo-nfc "npm --prefix functions test"
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-mgo-nfc "npm --prefix functions test -- test/rules"
scripts.adb:reverse: adb reverse tcp:9099 tcp:9099 && adb reverse tcp:8080 tcp:8080 && adb reverse tcp:5001 tcp:5001
